name: Turn Alignment (Mythic)
body:
You can make creatures of your hated alignment flee.

Prerequisites(s): Turn Alignment.

Benefit(s): Your turn alignment ability affects any creatures with the same alignment as those affected by non-mythic Turn Alignment (not just outsiders, neither just those with the alignment subtype), but these targets gain a +4 bonus on their Will save unless they have an aura of that alignment (like clerics, paladins and warpriests). Alternatively, you can expend two uses of mythic power when using Turn Alignment to affect all targets of the chosen alignment as if they had that alignment subtype.
